effect_description_eng:
[Main] You may play 1 [Guilmon] or [Takato Matsuki] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When an opponent's level 5 or higher Digimon is played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Gallantmon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
